## Flora of the W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula

To date, `r nrow(plant.summary)` vascular plant species have been recorded on the Saanich
Peninsula, drawing together `r nrow(plants)` records from historical collections, iNaturalist
observations and other sources. Each species falls into one of three groups:

<div class="saanich-status-tiles"></div>

Click a group to show only the records of those species, old and recent, on the map and
in the list. Click the same group again to clear the selection and show all species.
The map shows where records are concentrated. Open *Filters* to narrow them by recorder, pick a plant from the list to
see only its records, or use the shape tool at the top left of the map to draw an area, double-clicking to finish. Open *Records* below the map for the details behind each
selection.
